profile.headline: Frontend Developer @ Continued Vue / Nuxt / Wordpress
profile.summary:
At SiteZeus, our team excels in transforming digital landscapes, where my role as a Frontend Developer encompasses the migration of our company website to Vue/Nuxt. This pivotal project not only showcases my competencies in Vue, Nuxt, and Tailwind CSS but also underscores a deep understanding of user psychology honed through my academic background. 

Collaborating closely with the marketing division, we've executed seamless targeted email campaigns, leveraging my HubSpot acumen to enhance our outreach. Anchored in a passion for frontend innovation and continuous learning, I'm committed to steering our web presence to new heights, backed by a strong foundation in both technology and the behavioral sciences.

positions.title: Junior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Vue | Nuxt | Tailwind | Wordpress | Typescript 
Frontend Developer proficient in WordPress, Vue/Nuxt, and marketing automation. Currently leading the conversion of our company website from WordPress to Vue/Nuxt, while also maintaining our legacy WordPress site. Additionally, responsible for collaborating with the marketing team to execute targeted email campaigns using HubSpot. Thriving in a fast-paced environment, I leverage my technical skills and marketing automation knowledge to deliver high-quality web solutions and drive business growth.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description: Design, develop  and deploy mobile-first, dynamic and responsive web pages using Figma, Adobe Illustrator, HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript and VUE/NUXT.

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

projects.title: Drag and Drop Typescript Project
projects.description: Drag and drop typescript app based off Udemy's 'Understanding Typescript ' with Maximilian Schwarzmüller. I changed it from a project management list app to a book log and added the additional data of 'Date added' and 'Date finished.' Then next steps are to turn it into a true CRUD app. Stay tuned...

projects.title: Portfolio & Blog
projects.description: Markdown-powered blog and portfolio, styled with Tailwind CSS for a modern and responsive design. Uses Nuxt's file-based routing to efficiently manage content and a dark/light mode selector to enhance user experience by allowing theme switching.
